title: MoMint
tagline: NFT Marketplace for Influencers to Mint their Social Media Posts into NFTs
description: MoMint is an NFT platform that enables influencers and creators to seamlessly mint their social media posts as NFTs. By integrating with popular platforms like Instagram and Twitter, creators can monetize their moments, turning their photos, videos, and memories into valuable, tradeable digital assets. Fans can purchase these NFTs and, depending on the creator's set use cases, gain access to exclusive content, events, and NFT-gated experiences such as meet-ups, concerts, and special offers.
how_its_made:
MoMint is built using a combination of React, Thirdweb SDK, Web3Auth, Chainlink, Lit Protocol.
1.⁠ ⁠Frontend: Built using React.js and styled with Tailwind CSS for modern, responsive designs.
   - File Upload: Users can drag and drop files or import directly from their social media (Instagram and Twitter) using custom API integrations.
   - NFT Marketplace: A dynamic listing of available NFTs, allowing users to browse, filter by price, and purchase directly from the marketplace.
   - Event Section: Exclusive NFT-gated events are accessible based on token ownership, implemented via Lit Protocol.

2.⁠ ⁠Backend: 
   - Smart Contract: Using Thirdweb SDK, NFTs are minted on the Ethereum network (testnet for development). NFT metadata, including pricing, title, description, and media, are uploaded to IPFS for decentralized storage.
   - Authentication: Powered by Web3Auth, users can securely connect their crypto wallets to the platform for seamless NFT minting and purchasing.
   - NFT Pricing Data: Chainlink Oracles are used to fetch real-time ETH price data to display equivalent USD values for transparency when purchasing NFTs.
